İlgi alanlarımız; NASA'nın açık kaynaklı veri setlerini işlemek, uzay keşifleri ve gezegen bilimi odaklı interaktif modeller tasarlamak, yapay zekâ destekli çözümler ve sürdürülebilir uzay teknolojileri geliştirmektir.
summary:
Abandoned but Not Forgotten: From the Red Planet to Moon Dust, the Lonely Explorers" is an interactive digital children’s storybook celebrating the unsung, silent heroes of space exploration and the historic imprints they left behind. Through a blend of inspiring narratives and rich visuals, the project highlights the legacy of dormant pioneers—from the Apollo equipment and astronaut footprints preserved for millions of years in the airless environment of the Moon, to the legendary Opportunity (Oppy) rover, which survived 15 years on Mars despite a 90-day design life, sending a poignant final message before its batteries faded in a giant dust storm.
Because public and media attention is primarily captured by active space missions, the historical, emotional, and cultural significance of retired hardware left on other worlds is often overlooked or dismissed as mere space debris. This book addresses that challenge by transforming complex space history and "space archaeology" into an accessible, empathetic, and inspiring story for young readers and audiences of all ages.
Ultimately, this project is vital because it cultivates early awareness of space heritage—reminding us that these dormant machines are not junk, but humanity’s very first monuments of courage, destined to become the historic open-air museums for future generations living on the Moon and Mars.
details:
🚀 "Abandoned but Not Forgotten: From the Red Planet to Moon Dust, the Lonely Explorers" is an interactive digital children's storybook told through the silent legacy of humanity's pioneering spacecraft — cosmic explorers resting across the Moon and Mars. Through four thematic chapters, the story traces humanity’s courage in space exploration, highlighting how dormant hardware and footprints become permanent monuments of history. From Neil Armstrong’s preserved footprints on the airless Moon to Opportunity’s (Oppy) 15-year resilience on Mars, and from dusty valleys to future open-air museums, the tale blends science and storytelling.

💻 Tech Stack

  • StoryJumper / Interactive Digital Storytelling Platform
  • Calameo / Digital E-Book Publishing & Page-Flip Layout
  • Canva & AI-Assisted Visual Illustration Tools
  • Responsive Cross-Device Reading Layout (Mobile & Desktop Friendly)

Innovation Highlights

  • 📖 Narrative Design: Structured as a four-chapter emotional journey from the Moon to Mars.
  • 🔭 Educational Value: Each chapter introduces key planetary science and space heritage concepts.
  • 🎨 Visual Simplicity: Emphasis on high-contrast space illustrations, clear typography, and age-appropriate readability.
  • 📡 Data Trust: All scientific references and mission timelines sourced directly from NASA archives.
